name: operator47-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by operator47 — context optimization and workflow automation

plugins.name: plugin-lazy
plugins.description: Lazy-load disabled plugins on demand. Lists installed-but-disabled plugins, reads skills-only plugins from cache mid-session (no restart), or toggles agent-heavy plugins on/off (restart required).

plugins.name: session-review
plugins.description: Review what's open, pending, or stale in the current chat session before closing or continuing. Project-agnostic; surface-only — never edits any file.

plugins.name: python-venv
plugins.description: Set up a Python virtual environment in the current project. Prefers uv, falls back to stdlib python -m venv. Handles requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, and .gitignore automatically.
